source_title: UN human rights and AI in justice
direct_observation: predictive policing and biometric data can reinforce biased data over-policing and due-process risks; human-rights due diligence is recommended
missing_stage: named safety equal protection and remedy
next_test: audit tool against rights standards and affected-community outcomes

unit_or_scope: DHS agencies and more than 20 detection observation and monitoring technologies
direct_observation: agencies use facial recognition license-plate readers third-party data and AI-enabled analytics with gaps in bias and privacy assessment
missing_stage: fair deployment privacy protection and resident safety
next_test: trace data access bias assessment and complaint routes

unit_or_scope: US city transportation and law-enforcement technologies
direct_observation: cameras Bluetooth sensors and gunshot detectors may improve services but costs benefits privacy and civil-liberties risks remain

source_title: OJP crime information centres and crime
unit_or_scope: Baltimore district intelligence centres and ten years of crime data
direct_observation: effects were mixed and centres were generally associated with increases in recorded crime possibly reflecting improved detection and documentation
next_test: separate reporting detection and victimization outcomes

unit_or_scope: Michigan State Police treatment patrol areas 2019-2022
direct_observation: internal dashboard implementation had no impact on traffic-stop racial disparities
missing_stage: institutional behaviour change and community legitimacy
next_test: test whether dashboard use changes decisions with authority and incentives

source_title: OJP procedural justice and civilian oversight
unit_or_scope: 233 Philadelphia traffic stops observed with body-worn-camera footage
direct_observation: protocol measured participation dignity respect neutrality and trustworthy motives with reliable observation
missing_stage: resident safety cooperation and durable trust
next_test: pair procedural-justice observation with resident trust and safety outcomes
